### Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. Announces First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call


April 15, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/352443609/files/doc_news/Sabra-Health-Care-REIT-Inc--Announces-First-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-Date-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


TUSTIN, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBRA) announced today that it will issue its 2026 first quarter earnings release on April 29, 2026, after the close of trading.


A conference call with a simultaneous webcast to discuss the 2026 first quarter results will be held on Thursday, April 30th at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time. The dial-in number for U.S. participants is 888-880-4448. For participants outside the U.S., the dial-in number is 646-960-0572. The conference ID number is 1382596.


The webcast URL is[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/961345479](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F961345479&esheet=54510420&newsitemid=20260415346369&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F961345479&index=1&md5=1e1177482d5f8ea631e3382ac6575f96) . A digital replay of the call will be available on our website at[www.sabrahealth.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabrahealth.com&esheet=54510420&newsitemid=20260415346369&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sabrahealth.com&index=2&md5=7e6c286c2432c8533348a45b1f77a177) .


**About Sabra**


Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc., a Maryland corporation, operates as a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust (a "REIT") that, through its subsidiaries, owns and invests in real estate serving the healthcare industry throughout the United States and Canada.


Investor & Media Inquiries: 1-888-393-8248 orinvestorinquiries@sabrahealth.com
